title: Neural Operators with Adaptive Spectral and Low-Rank Representations
affiliations: Russian Academy of Sciences (RAS) - Central Economics and Mathematics Institute, MIREA-Russian Technological University, Financial University under the Government of the Russian Federation and Financial University under the Government of the Russian Federation

detail.title: Neural Operators with Adaptive Spectral and Low-Rank Representations
detail.abstract: Neural operators provide a data-driven framework for learning mappings between spaces of functions and have shown strong performance in scientific computing and surrogate modeling. However, many existing architectures rely on a single representation of input functions, which can limit their ability to capture both local variability and global structure. In this work, we propose a neural operator that integrates pointwise, spectral, and low-rank representations of the input function within a unified DeepONet-style formulation. A spectral branch based on Chebyshev polynomials and a lowrank linear embedding introduce structured inductive biases, while learnable gating mechanisms adaptively fuse different representations. The resulting operator (NOASLRR) preserves mesh-invariance and improves representation efficiency, making it applicable to a wide range of operator learning tasks. This study of mathematical optimization methods and algorithms for computational models continues to form a solid scientific foundation for finding a balance between computational speed and forecast quality, reducing the computational models complexity without losing the results quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新型神经算子NOASLRR，通过整合点值、谱和低秩三种输入函数表示，在DeepONet框架下实现了对局部变异性和全局结构的更好捕捉，提高了表示效率并保持网格不变性。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种神经算子架构，能够同时有效地捕捉输入函数的局部变异性和全局结构，从而提高算子学习的表示效率和性能？
AI.motivation: 现有神经算子架构通常只使用单一输入函数表示（如点值表示），这限制了它们同时捕捉局部细节和全局结构的能力，导致表示效率不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于DeepONet框架，整合函数表示理论（点值表示、谱表示、低秩表示），引入结构化归纳偏置（切比雪夫多项式谱分支、低秩线性嵌入）和可学习门控机制。
AI.method: 提出NOASLRR（Neural Operator with Adaptive Spectral and Low-Rank Representations）架构，包含三个分支：点值分支、基于切比雪夫多项式的谱分支、低秩线性嵌入分支，通过可学习门控机制自适应融合不同表示。
AI.findings: NOASLRR保持了网格不变性，提高了表示效率，能够更好地平衡计算速度与预测质量，降低计算模型复杂度而不损失结果质量，适用于广泛的算子学习任务。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了多表示融合的神经算子理论框架；2）引入了结构化归纳偏置机制；3）发展了自适应门控融合方法；4）扩展了DeepONet架构的表达能力。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提供了更高效的算子学习工具；2）适用于科学计算和代理建模；3）平衡了计算复杂度与预测精度；4）为复杂计算模型提供了简化方法。

title: Artificial Intelligence and Risk-Taking in Banking
affiliations: Babeş-Bolyai University of Cluj-Napoca, , Babes-Bolyai University - Department of Finance and University of Zurich

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence and Risk-Taking in Banking
detail.abstract: We study how banks’ adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) affects risk-taking and stability using data on major listed Chinese banks (2013–2024). We construct an AI-intensity index from agent adoption, cloud computing, and big data measures. Higher AI intensity is associated with greater risk and lower stability: a one–standard deviation increase reduces the Z‑score by 0.25 units (about 22%) next year. This operates mainly via higher earnings volatility and lower profitability, not weaker capitalization. The effect is stronger for banks with low liquidity, unstable funding, and weak loss-absorption, implying AI can amplify risk and requires tighter prudential oversight.

AI.tldr: 研究中国主要上市银行AI采用对风险承担和稳定性的影响，发现AI强度越高，银行风险越大、稳定性越低，主要通过增加盈利波动性和降低盈利能力实现，而非资本充足率恶化。
AI.research_question: 银行采用人工智能如何影响其风险承担和稳定性？
AI.motivation: AI在银行业的应用日益广泛，但其对银行风险承担和金融稳定的影响尚不明确，需要实证研究来指导监管政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融中介理论、风险管理理论和金融稳定理论，探讨AI技术如何改变银行的风险承担行为和稳定性。
AI.method: 使用2013-2024年中国主要上市银行数据，构建AI强度指数（基于智能代理采用、云计算和大数据指标），采用面板回归分析AI强度与风险指标（Z-score）的关系。
AI.findings: AI强度越高，银行风险越大、稳定性越低：AI强度增加一个标准差，下一年Z-score下降0.25个单位（约22%）。主要通过增加盈利波动性和降低盈利能力实现，而非资本充足率恶化。效应在低流动性、不稳定融资和弱损失吸收能力的银行中更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统实证检验银行AI采用对风险承担的影响机制，揭示了AI通过盈利渠道而非资本渠道影响稳定性的新机制，丰富了金融科技与金融稳定理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供重要政策启示：AI可能放大银行风险，需要加强审慎监管，特别是对流动性差、融资不稳定、损失吸收能力弱的银行；银行在采用AI时应加强风险管理。

title: Unveiling the role of rational inattention: Tax incentives and participation in commercial pension insurance
affiliations: Guangdong University of Technology, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Guangdong University of Technology

detail.title: Unveiling the role of rational inattention: Tax incentives and participation in commercial pension insurance
detail.abstract: This paper examines why tax incentives fail to stimulate participation in China's third-pillar commercial pension insurance, emphasizing the role of rational inattention. Using household survey data from China Family Panel Studies (CFPS) spanning 2014-2022 and a difference-in-differences-in-differences (DDD) design, we find that pilot policy generated a statistically insignificant average effect on participation, with rational inattention - proxied by financial literacy - explaining much of its ineffectiveness. We develop a dynamic consumption-portfolio model featuring costly information acquisition, and then resolve limitations of standard models through a dynamic framework with distinct savings channels and policy-focused rational inattention. The models show that rational inattention distorts perceptions of tax benefits and wage growth, raising participation costs, while multiple savings channels dilute incentives. Only households with higher financial literacy substantially respond to the policy. Our results reveal how cognitive frictions undermine pension reform and offer implications for designing behaviorally-informed retirement schemes.

AI.tldr: 研究发现中国第三支柱商业养老保险税收优惠政策效果不显著，主要原因是理性疏忽（通过金融素养衡量）导致对税收优惠感知不足，多个储蓄渠道稀释了激励效果，只有高金融素养家庭对政策有显著反应。
AI.research_question: 为什么税收优惠政策未能有效刺激中国第三支柱商业养老保险的参与？理性疏忽在其中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 中国第三支柱商业养老保险的税收优惠政策实施效果不佳，参与率低，需要理解政策失效的原因，特别是行为经济学中的理性疏忽如何影响政策效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 理性疏忽理论（Rational Inattention）、动态消费-投资组合模型、信息获取成本理论、多储蓄渠道框架
AI.method: 使用中国家庭追踪调查（CFPS）2014-2022年数据，采用三重差分法（DDD）设计，金融素养作为理性疏忽的代理变量，构建包含信息获取成本的动态消费-投资组合模型
AI.findings: 试点政策对参与率的平均效应统计上不显著；理性疏忽扭曲了对税收优惠和工资增长的感知，提高了参与成本；多个储蓄渠道稀释了激励效果；只有金融素养较高的家庭对政策有显著反应
AI.theory_contributions: 将理性疏忽理论应用于养老金政策分析，构建包含信息获取成本和多储蓄渠道的动态框架，扩展了标准模型，揭示了认知摩擦如何影响政策效果
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供行为经济学视角的政策设计启示，建议考虑认知摩擦因素，针对不同金融素养群体设计差异化激励措施，提高养老金改革效果

title: Cryptographic Security Assessment of IBM z/OS Mainframe Infrastructure Using CASI Distributional Analysis

detail.title: Cryptographic Security Assessment of IBM z/OS Mainframe Infrastructure Using CASI Distributional Analysis
detail.abstract: We present a comprehensive cryptographic security assessment of IBM z/OS mainframe infrastructure using the Compression-Adjusted Structural Integrity (CASI) metric-a blackbox statistical method for detecting non-random structure in byte sequences (IEEE peerreviewed, ICECET 2026). Our analysis spans 50 findings across RACF password hashing, TN3270 protocol security, AT-TLS enforcement, IBM MQ channel encryption, and ICSF cryptographic authorization. The core finding is that RACF Legacy DES key derivation reduces effective key entropy from 56 bits to 42.17 bits through EBCDIC encoding dead zones, enabling complete keyspace exhaustion in 7.6 minutes on consumer GPU hardware ($0.08 cloud cost). We validate this finding bit-for-bit on real IBM z15 hardware (z/OS V2.5) via the vendor's educational z/OS platform, achieving 4/4 perfect matches between our model and the production RACF implementation. Beyond RACF, we discover that the vendor's educational z/OS infrastructure runs TN3270 without AT-TLS encryption (credentials in cleartext), operates IBM MQ V9.4.5 with all 23 channels unencrypted, and configures ICSF hardware cryptography without RACF authorization checks. A ghost AT-TLS policy from 2016 exists for an unused port but was never applied to the production TN3270 service. All testing was performed within authorized environments: Hercules 4.9.1 emulation with TK5 MVS 3.8j for initial analysis, and the vendor's educational platform (real IBM z15) for production validation. External systems discovered in MQ channel configurations were not accessed. 97 configuration artifacts are available to the vendor upon request.

AI.tldr: 本文使用CASI度量对IBM z/OS大型机基础设施进行全面的加密安全评估，发现RACF传统DES密钥派生因EBCDIC编码死区将有效密钥熵从56位降至42.17位，可在消费级GPU硬件上7.6分钟内穷举密钥空间（云成本0.08美元）。此外发现教育平台存在TN3270未加密、IBM MQ通道未加密、ICSF无授权检查等安全问题。
AI.research_question: IBM z/OS大型机基础设施的加密安全性如何？特别是RACF密码哈希、TN3270协议安全、AT-TLS执行、IBM MQ通道加密和ICSF加密授权等关键组件的安全性状况。
AI.motivation: 大型机系统在金融、政府和关键基础设施中广泛使用，但其加密安全性的系统性评估相对缺乏。IBM z/OS作为主流大型机操作系统，其安全配置对保护敏感数据至关重要，需要实证评估来识别潜在漏洞。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采用压缩调整结构完整性（CASI）度量——一种用于检测字节序列中非随机结构的黑盒统计方法（IEEE同行评审，ICECET 2026）。该方法基于信息论和密码学原理，通过分析数据结构的随机性来评估加密强度。
AI.method: 使用CASI度量进行黑盒统计分析，在授权环境中进行测试：Hercules 4.9.1仿真器（TK5 MVS 3.8j）进行初步分析，供应商教育平台（真实IBM z15硬件，z/OS V2.5）进行生产验证。分析涵盖50个发现，包括RACF密码哈希、TN3270协议、AT-TLS、IBM MQ通道和ICSF授权。
AI.findings: 1. RACF传统DES密钥派生因EBCDIC编码死区将有效密钥熵从56位降至42.17位，可在消费级GPU上7.6分钟内穷举（云成本0.08美元）。2. 教育平台TN3270未启用AT-TLS加密（凭据明文传输）。3. IBM MQ V9.4.5所有23个通道未加密。4. ICSF硬件加密未配置RACF授权检查。5. 存在2016年未使用的AT-TLS策略但未应用于生产TN3270服务。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次将CASI度量应用于大型机加密安全评估，验证了该方法在真实生产环境中的有效性。2. 揭示了EBCDIC编码对密码熵的实际影响，为密码学中的字符编码安全提供了新见解。3. 建立了大型机加密配置的系统性评估框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为IBM z/OS管理员提供了具体的安全配置建议和修复指南。2. 识别了可被实际利用的安全漏洞，包括低成本暴力破解攻击路径。3. 提供了97个配置工件供供应商改进产品安全性。4. 展示了教育平台与生产环境安全配置的差异，强调了测试环境安全的重要性。

title: Political Ideology and Managerial Learning from Stock Price
affiliations: Simon Fraser University, Simon Fraser University (SFU) - Beedie School of Business and Simon Fraser University (SFU) - Beedie School of Business

detail.title: Political Ideology and Managerial Learning from Stock Price
detail.abstract: Stock prices contain information beyond managers’ information sets. While prior research examines how firm- and regulatory-level features relate to the flow of price information into managerial decisions, less is known about whether managerial characteristics are associated with heterogeneity in how investment decisions covary with price-based signals. We examine this question by focusing on CEO political ideology and drawing on insights from the uncertainty-threat framework in political psychology. Using the standard investment-to-q framework, we document that firms led by Republican-oriented CEOs exhibit a weaker association between investment and stock-price signals in settings where prices are more likely to impound private information. Overall, our findings provide evidence of systematic heterogeneity across firms in the relation between investment decisions and stock-price information.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，共和党倾向的CEO在投资决策中对股价信号的反应较弱，特别是在股价更可能包含私有信息的情况下，这表明CEO政治意识形态会影响企业投资对股价信息的敏感度。
AI.research_question: CEO政治意识形态是否与投资决策对股价信号的反应差异相关？具体而言，共和党倾向的CEO是否表现出投资与股价信号之间较弱的关联？
AI.motivation: 股价包含超出管理者信息集的信息，先前研究关注企业和监管层面特征如何影响价格信息流入管理决策，但对管理者特征是否导致投资决策对价格信号反应的异质性了解不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于政治心理学中的不确定性-威胁框架，探讨CEO政治意识形态如何影响其对股价信息的反应模式。
AI.method: 采用标准的投资-q框架，分析CEO政治意识形态与投资-股价信号关联之间的关系，特别关注股价更可能包含私有信息的情境。
AI.findings: 共和党倾向的CEO领导的企业在投资与股价信号之间表现出较弱的关联，特别是在股价更可能包含私有信息的情况下。
AI.theory_contributions: 将政治心理学理论引入公司金融研究，揭示了CEO个人特征（政治意识形态）如何系统性地影响企业投资决策对市场信息的反应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者、董事会和监管机构提供了关于CEO政治意识形态如何影响企业投资效率的新见解，有助于更好地理解企业决策异质性。

title: Air Pollution and Demand for Environmental Spending
affiliations: Drexel University

detail.title: Air Pollution and Demand for Environmental Spending
detail.abstract: I link daily EPA air pollution data with restricted-use General Social Survey interviews from 2000-2023 to study how physical exposure to air pollution and information exposure from local air quality advisory changes correlate with support for government spending on environmental protection. Physical exposure to PM10 and increases in air quality advisory levels at EPA-designated thresholds are both associated with temporarily greater support for environmental spending, yet both effects vanish within one month. These results suggest that deteriorating environmental conditions may not generate sufficiently durable public support to sustain climate-related fiscal commitments.

AI.tldr: 将2000-2023年EPA空气污染数据与综合社会调查数据关联，研究发现PM10物理暴露和空气质量预警信息都会暂时增加环保支出支持，但效果在一个月内消失，表明环境恶化可能无法产生持久的公众支持来维持气候相关的财政承诺。
AI.research_question: 空气污染的物理暴露和空气质量预警信息如何影响公众对政府环保支出的支持？这种影响是否持久？
AI.motivation: 了解环境条件恶化是否能够产生持久的公众支持来维持气候相关的财政承诺，这对于环境政策的制定和实施至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合环境心理学、行为经济学和信息处理理论，探讨物理暴露和信息暴露对公众政策偏好的影响机制。
AI.method: 将EPA每日空气污染数据与2000-2023年综合社会调查（GSS）的受限使用数据进行关联分析，采用时间序列和面板数据分析方法。
AI.findings: PM10物理暴露和EPA空气质量预警级别的增加都会暂时提高对环保支出的支持，但两种效应都在一个月内消失，表明影响是暂时的而非持久的。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了环境暴露对政策支持的暂时性效应，挑战了环境恶化会自动产生持久政策支持的传统假设，为理解环境态度形成的时间动态提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供重要启示：仅靠环境条件恶化可能无法获得持久的公众支持，需要更系统的政策沟通和公众参与策略来维持气候相关的财政承诺。

title: Optimal electricity consumption and storage under short-term renewable supply variability
affiliations: University Grenoble Alpes, Aix-Marseille University - Aix-Marseille School of Economics and Aix-Marseille University - Aix-Marseille School of Economics

detail.title: Optimal electricity consumption and storage under short-term renewable supply variability
detail.abstract: The expansion of intermittent electricity increases supply variability and requires greater flexibility from consumers. This results in welfare losses for these agents, which can nevertheless be mitigated by energy storage. Our model analyzes these welfare consequences in the context of short-term variability in renewable energy given fixed dispatchable and storage capacities. We explore an optimal control problem that determines a welfare-maximizing electricity consumption path by adjusting dispatchable and stored energy throughout the short-term production cycle of renewables. This optimization problem identifies three regimes (no storage and active storage, with or without capacity constraints) and provides the associated consumer welfare over this cycle. Under all three regimes, a certain degree of consumer flexibility is part of the optimal solution and entails welfare losses. Active storage reduces these losses but cannot eliminate them completely due to the energy conversion losses induced by this activity. However, when storage capacity is constrained, a proactive adjustment of this capacity can offset the losses.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了间歇性电力扩张背景下，消费者灵活性需求带来的福利损失，以及储能如何缓解这些损失。通过最优控制模型，识别了三种储能机制，发现主动储能能减少但不能完全消除福利损失，而受容量约束时，主动调整容量可抵消损失。
AI.research_question: 在可再生能源短期波动性背景下，消费者灵活性需求如何影响福利？储能如何缓解这些福利损失？
AI.motivation: 间歇性电力扩张增加了供应波动性，要求消费者具备更大灵活性，这导致消费者福利损失。储能技术可能缓解这些损失，但需要系统分析其效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最优控制理论、福利经济学、能源系统建模。研究构建了福利最大化的电力消费路径优化模型。
AI.method: 构建最优控制问题模型，确定在可再生能源短期生产周期内，通过调整可调度能源和储能来实现福利最大化的电力消费路径。模型识别了三种机制：无储能、主动储能（有无容量约束）。
AI.findings: 1. 所有三种机制下，一定程度的消费者灵活性都是最优解的一部分，但会导致福利损失；2. 主动储能能减少这些损失，但由于能量转换损失无法完全消除；3. 当储能容量受限时，主动调整容量可以抵消福利损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了分析间歇性电力背景下消费者福利损失的理论框架；2. 识别了三种储能机制及其福利影响；3. 揭示了储能容量约束下的最优调整策略。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为电力系统规划者提供了储能配置的决策依据；2. 帮助政策制定者理解消费者灵活性需求的福利影响；3. 为储能技术投资提供了经济性分析框架。

title: Bridging an energy system model with an ensemble deep-learning approach for electricity price forecasting
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Duisburg-Essen and Brandenburg University of Technology Cottbus-Senftenberg

detail.title: Bridging an energy system model with an ensemble deep-learning approach for electricity price forecasting
detail.abstract: Rising renewables and market liberalisation increase price uncertainty, heightening volatility and spikes, complicating accurate price modelling and forecasting for stakeholders. Electricity price forecasting spans econometric/data driven models (stronger short-term) and fundamental energy system models (stronger long-term). We combine a European energy system model with a state-of-the-art deep learning model to unify both paradigms. The design leverages the strengths of both model structures, enabling it to capture all key parameters of power markets, including bidding behaviour, storage dispatch, available capacities, demand, renewable generation, and related fuel and carbon markets. We test the combined model in Europe’s largest power market over six years and benchmark it against multiple econometric alternatives in a forecasting study. The results and robustness checks show that (1) incorporating energy system model (ESM) outputs as exogenous features improves the forecasting accuracy of all econometric models; (2) the ensemble deep neural network (Ens-DNN) performs best on our dataset; and (3) adding ESM outputs further improves Ens-DNN accuracy by an average of 6% (RMSE). The empirical relevance of the forecast improvement is confirmed by results from an exemplary storage optimisation, in which incorporating the techno-economic energy system model increases revenue by up to 10%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合能源系统模型和深度学习模型的新方法，用于提高电力价格预测精度，在欧洲最大电力市场验证显示预测误差平均降低6%，储能优化收益提升达10%
AI.research_question: 如何有效结合能源系统模型和深度学习模型来提高电力价格预测的准确性？
AI.motivation: 可再生能源增长和市场自由化增加了价格不确定性，加剧了价格波动和尖峰，使得准确的价格建模和预测对利益相关者变得更加复杂
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合两种电力价格预测范式：计量经济学/数据驱动模型（短期预测优势）和基础能源系统模型（长期预测优势）
AI.method: 将欧洲能源系统模型与最先进的深度学习模型结合，利用集成深度神经网络（Ens-DNN）并加入ESM输出作为外生特征
AI.findings: 1) 加入ESM输出提高了所有计量经济模型的预测精度；2) Ens-DNN在数据集上表现最佳；3) 加入ESM输出使Ens-DNN的RMSE平均提高6%；储能优化收益提升达10%
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了统一两种电力价格预测范式的新理论框架，证明了结合能源系统模型和深度学习模型的理论优势
AI.practical_contributions: 为电力市场参与者提供了更准确的预测工具，实证显示可提高储能优化收益达10%，具有显著的经济价值

title: Optimal Choice under Costly Precision: Entropy Regularization as a Special Case

detail.title: Optimal Choice under Costly Precision: Entropy Regularization as a Special Case
detail.abstract: Standard models often attribute probabilistic or noisy choice to preference heterogeneity or ad hoc stochastic disturbances, while a parallel literature introduces entropy regularization to discipline behavior, frequently invoking information-theoretic analogies. This note develops an economics-native framework in which the precision of choice is a costly, endogenous control variable, distinct from preferences and uncertainty. Agents optimally choose both actions and the precision with which actions respond to payoffs, trading off expected utility against explicit costs of fine discrimination. Precision governs not only the sharpness of response but also the granularity of payoff-relevant distinctions that enter optimization, rendering the effective choice domain endogenous. Within this framework, smooth or probabilistic choice arises as an optimal response to costly precision rather than as a behavioral anomaly. Entropyregularized (Gibbs/logit) rules emerge as a special case under a canonical convex specification, while alternative cost structures yield different smooth behaviors. The approach clarifies welfare, comparative statics, and coordination. The contribution is conceptual rather than behavioral: it clarifies that smooth choice need not reflect noisy preferences but may arise from optimal control under costly precision.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个经济学原生框架，将选择精度作为内生的成本控制变量，而非偏好异质性或随机扰动。在权衡期望效用与精细区分成本下，代理人同时优化行动和精度，平滑选择成为最优而非行为异常。
AI.research_question: 如何从经济学角度解释平滑或概率性选择行为？选择精度作为内生控制变量的框架如何统一解释熵正则化等现有模型？
AI.motivation: 标准模型通常将概率性或噪声选择归因于偏好异质性或特设随机扰动，而熵正则化文献常借用信息论类比。需要建立经济学原生框架，将选择精度视为有成本的内生控制变量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 选择精度作为内生控制变量框架：代理人同时选择行动和精度，权衡期望效用与精细区分成本。精度不仅控制响应锐度，还决定进入优化的收益相关区分的粒度，使有效选择域内生。
AI.method: 概念性分析框架：建立经济学原生理论模型，将精度作为内生变量，分析不同成本结构下的最优选择行为。熵正则化（Gibbs/logit）规则作为凸成本规范的特例。
AI.findings: 平滑或概率性选择是成本精度下的最优响应，而非行为异常。熵正则化规则在凸成本规范下作为特例出现，不同成本结构产生不同平滑行为。框架澄清了福利、比较静态和协调问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 概念性贡献：阐明平滑选择不必反映噪声偏好，而是成本精度下的最优控制结果。提供统一框架解释熵正则化等现象，使选择精度成为经济学原生概念而非信息论借用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解实际决策行为提供新视角：决策者可能因区分成本而选择"模糊"决策。对政策设计、机制设计和行为经济学有启示，特别是在协调博弈和福利分析中。

title: AI Must go to School, not only be Trained on Massive Datasets - Toward the Institutional Education of Machine Intelligence
affiliations: University of the People

detail.title: AI Must go to School, not only be Trained on Massive Datasets - Toward the Institutional Education of Machine Intelligence
detail.abstract: The rapid integration of large language models into scientific and knowledge-intensive workflows has revealed a structural asymmetry between generative capacity and epistemic validation. While contemporary foundation models achieve remarkable fluency through large-scale statistical optimization, empirical evidence consistently demonstrates persistent hallucination phenomena, including unsupported claims, citation errors, and miscalibrated confidence. These instabilities are not incidental defects but structural consequences of probabilistic sequence generation operating outside institutional validation frameworks.This article advances a central thesis: artificial intelligence does not merely require more data or larger models—it requires institutional education. Drawing on science-of-science research, hallucination studies, retrieval-grounded architectures, and multi-agent research systems, we conceptualize “school” as computational embedding within structured epistemic infrastructures. Education, in this framework, entails curriculum-level knowledge architectures, claim-level certification thresholds, ensemble-based validation, provenance logging, and governance feedback loops.We argue that hallucination can be reframed as institutional absence rather than technical anomaly. By embedding falsifiability constraints, replication stability requirements, and evidence-bound citation graphs directly into inference pipelines, generative systems transition from statistical intelligence to institutional intelligence. Such embedding not only enhances epistemic reliability but also reduces generative entropy, improves compute-normalized epistemic yield, and mitigates recursive amplification risks in networked knowledge ecosystems.The proposed Autonomous Scientific School constitutes a blueprint for AI-native epistemic governance in which generation and validation co-evolve within the same computational substrate. Rather than replacing human science, this framework supports dual-track coevolution: machine-scale structured validation combined with human normative oversight. Artificial intelligence, we conclude, does not require unlimited scale—it requires institutional integration.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出，大型语言模型的幻觉问题不是技术缺陷，而是制度缺失的结果。作者主张通过"制度教育"将AI嵌入结构化认知基础设施中，构建"自主科学学校"框架，使生成与验证在同一计算基板上共同演化。
AI.research_question: 如何将大型语言模型从统计智能转变为制度智能，以解决其幻觉问题并实现可靠的认知验证？
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在科学和知识密集型工作流程中表现出生成能力与认知验证之间的结构性不对称，幻觉现象（如无支持的主张、引用错误、置信度校准不当）持续存在，这些不是偶然缺陷而是概率序列生成在制度验证框架外操作的结构性后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 科学科学研究、幻觉研究、检索增强架构、多智能体研究系统，以及将"学校"概念化为结构化认知基础设施中的计算嵌入。
AI.method: 概念性框架构建，提出"自主科学学校"作为AI原生认知治理蓝图，包括课程级知识架构、主张级认证阈值、基于集成的验证、来源记录和治理反馈循环。
AI.findings: 通过将可证伪性约束、复制稳定性要求和证据绑定引用图直接嵌入推理管道，生成系统可以从统计智能转变为制度智能。这种嵌入不仅增强了认知可靠性，还减少了生成熵，提高了计算归一化的认知产出，并减轻了网络化知识生态系统中的递归放大风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将幻觉重新定义为制度缺失而非技术异常；2. 提出"制度教育"作为AI发展的核心需求；3. 构建"自主科学学校"作为AI原生认知治理的理论框架；4. 提出生成与验证在同一计算基板上共同演化的双轨协同进化模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为AI系统设计提供了具体的制度嵌入机制；2. 提出了减少生成熵和提高认知产出的实用方法；3. 为网络化知识生态系统中的风险缓解提供了治理框架；4. 支持机器规模结构化验证与人类规范监督相结合的双轨协同进化实践。

title: Common Property and Conflict in Ethiopia: The Case of the Afar, Somali, and Karamojong Cluster Pastoralists

detail.title: Common Property and Conflict in Ethiopia: The Case of the Afar, Somali, and Karamojong Cluster Pastoralists
detail.abstract: Pastoralism is a primary form of livelihood on the Horn of Africa and pastoral commons are particularly difficult in terms of conflict and conflict resolution (Fratkin, 1994; Gebre-Mariam, 1994; Ocan, 1994; Salih, 1994; Unruh, 1995a). Common property resources (CPRs) play a fundamental role in pastoral livelihood, identity, and conflict (Gadamu, 1994; Gebre Mariam, 1994; Ocan, 1994; Salih, 1994; Unruh, 1995b). Because few institutions can endure the stresses of armed conflict (Ostrom, 1999), conflict prone areas such as the Horn can seem particularly distant from opportunities to derive workable institutional arrangements able to effectively manage contested commonly held land. Using the relevant literature together with fieldwork, this paper presents three cases of armed confrontation over pastoral commons in Ethiopia and the developments which have led to significant opportunities for conflict resolution and rule-making. Subsequent to a broad description of the Ethiopian pastoral commons and the cases involving the Afar, Somali, and  Karamojong Cluster commons, the article discusses the salient features of these cases and their socio-political contexts which can lend themselves to the development of workable institutions for commons conflict resolution and management. The relevant fieldwork took place over 13 months in Ethiopia, complimented by one month of fieldwork in Djibouti and Kenya.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨埃塞俄比亚牧区公地在武装冲突背景下如何发展有效制度进行冲突解决和规则制定，通过三个案例研究分析冲突解决机会。
AI.research_question: 在埃塞俄比亚牧区公地武装冲突频发的背景下，如何发展可行制度来有效解决冲突和管理争议公地？
AI.motivation: 牧区公地在非洲之角对牧民生计、身份认同和冲突至关重要，但武装冲突地区往往缺乏能够承受冲突压力的制度安排，需要探索在冲突环境中发展有效管理机制的可能性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共财产资源(CPRs)理论、制度分析框架、冲突解决理论，特别是奥斯特罗姆的制度可持续性理论。
AI.method: 文献综述结合实地研究，包括13个月在埃塞俄比亚的田野调查，以及在吉布提和肯尼亚各1个月的补充调查，采用三个案例研究法（阿法尔、索马里和卡拉莫琼集群公地）。
AI.findings: 即使在武装冲突频发的埃塞俄比亚牧区，也存在发展可行制度解决公地冲突的机会；三个案例展示了冲突解决和规则制定的具体发展路径；特定社会政治背景特征有助于制度发展。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了冲突环境中制度发展的理论，挑战了"武装冲突地区难以建立有效制度"的假设，为冲突地区的公共资源管理提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为埃塞俄比亚及其他冲突地区牧区公地管理提供实践指导，识别了有助于冲突解决制度发展的社会政治因素，为政策制定者和实践者提供了具体案例参考。

title: Land Rights and Peacebuilding: Challenges and Responses for the International Community

detail.title: Land Rights and Peacebuilding: Challenges and Responses for the International Community
detail.abstract: Rectifying land rights in war-torn settings are among the most daunting challenges of peacebuilding. War-torn land tenure situations are unique settings in their combination of a weakened and chaotic formal (statutory) system, vigorous but very fluid informal tenure activity, along with the presence of political demands regarding land, and international actors that have a large interest and influence in the success of any improvement or recovery. While this combination carries risks, it also represents real opportunity for practical and policy reform in the formal and customary land tenure sectors of countries recovering from armed conflict. In this regard the statutory tenure reorganization and reform efforts supported by the UN need to assess how the development of informal tenure institutions, problems, and processes are proceeding ‗on the ground', so as to draw legitimacy from these processes into reformulating national tenure structure, policy, law, and enforcement; thereby contributing to durable peace. This has the advantage of working ‗with the grain,' and building on what has already been learned, disseminated, and accepted within the informal tenure system as the formal legal system is being reformed and implemented-as opposed to expecting people to disengage from binding customary obligations involving land when improved formal laws are finally enacted and enforced. Without this purposeful connection, tenure institutions at different levels risk evolving in different directions, with considerable difficulty and volatility later on for any attempts to reconnect them. With such a connection however, new policy can support what people are already doing, and engage in ongoing issues of disputing, resettlement, restitution, proof of claim, and the role of land and property in economic development. In post-crisis settings, new laws have the opportunity to address land and property issues in the context of what people are already doing ‗on the ground', with a view to moving from the fluidity of crisis situations to a more solidified and peaceful social and legal environment as an outcome. Positive examples exist, and several are presented in this paper. The article discusses the primary challenges regarding land rights in war-torn settings and then attaches to these both practical and policy options for overcoming them. The paper draws on the author's land tenure experience in 15 wartorn countries.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨战后土地权属重建的挑战与机遇，主张正式土地制度改革应基于并整合非正式土地制度实践，以实现持久和平。
AI.research_question: 在战乱后环境中，如何通过整合正式与非正式土地制度来有效重建土地权属体系，促进和平建设？
AI.motivation: 战后土地权属重建面临独特挑战：正式制度薄弱混乱、非正式制度活跃但流动、政治诉求复杂、国际干预影响大。这种复杂性既是风险也是改革机遇。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度理论（正式与非正式制度互动）、和平建设理论、土地权属治理理论、冲突后重建理论
AI.method: 基于作者在15个战乱国家的土地权属实践经验，结合案例分析，提出政策建议
AI.findings: 成功的土地权属重建需要"顺势而为"，将正式制度改革建立在非正式制度实践基础上，避免两者脱节。存在积极案例表明这种整合方法可行。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了战后土地权属重建的整合理论框架，强调正式与非正式制度的协同演化，丰富了和平建设与制度变迁理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为联合国等国际组织提供具体政策建议：如何评估"实地"非正式制度发展，将其纳入国家土地政策、法律和执行体系，解决争议、重新安置、权利证明等实际问题。
